name: Anti-PL-7 Antisynthetase Syndrome

criteria.description: Clinical or laboratory evidence of inflammatory myopathy (elevated CK, muscle weakness, or biopsy)
Radiologic or histopathologic evidence of interstitial lung disease
Non-erosive arthritis involving small and/or large joints
Characteristic hyperkeratotic skin changes on the lateral and palmar aspects of the fingers

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of anti-PL-7 antibodies plus at least two major criteria (myositis and/or interstitial lung disease) or one major and one minor/supportive criterion
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of myositis and interstitial lung disease.

searchTerms: autoantibody associated with muscle and lung disease
immune marker for myositis and lung involvement

pathognomonic.notes: Often presenting symptom with variable severity
Proximal muscle weakness and elevated muscle enzymes

common.notes: Hyperkeratotic and fissured skin on fingers
Vasospasm of digits triggered by cold or stress

searchTerms: mild high blood pressure in lungs

rare.notes: Calcium deposits in skin, rare in antisynthetase syndrome

laboratory: Positive anti-PL-7 antibodies by immunoprecipitation or ELISA
imaging: High-resolution CT showing ground-glass opacities and fibrosis consistent with interstitial lung disease
MRI of muscles showing edema and inflammation
Chest X-ray with reticular or nodular infiltrates
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; association with HLA-DRB1* alleles reported
other: Muscle biopsy showing perifascicular atrophy and inflammatory infiltrates
Pulmonary function tests demonstrating restrictive pattern and reduced diffusion capacity

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of anti-PL-12 antibodies instead of anti-PL-7
More predominant lung involvement with less myositis
Characteristic heliotrope rash and Gottron papules
Absence of myositis and antisynthetase antibodies
Progressive lung fibrosis without systemic autoimmune features

redFlags: Severe muscle weakness with respiratory compromise
references: Meyer A, et al. Antisynthetase syndrome: clinical and serological features. Autoimmun Rev. 2017;16(1):1-7.
Fathi M, et al. Anti-PL-7 antisynthetase syndrome: clinical features and outcomes. J Rheumatol. 2013;40(12):2039-2045.
Marie I, et al. Interstitial lung disease in antisynthetase syndrome: a retrospective study of 75 patients. Arthritis Rheum. 2013;65(2):409-417.
